name.description: For a new account: display name (default: the one in the invitation).

password.description:
For a new account: a password (12 to 128 characters). Omit to sign in later with a link
or add a passkey with the tokens returned here.

token.description: The token from the invitation mail.

oneOf.description:
Tokens of a new session when a new account was created; `null` when you accepted with
your existing account.

user_id.description: The account that now has the roles.

ActionInfo.description: An MCP tool that a rule can run as an action.

needs_approval.description:
The tool deletes or overwrites data, or needs a person's approval when an agent calls it:
in a rule, the step waits for a person to approve each run.

ActivityItem.description: One line of a record's activity: a note, or an event recorded about it.

text.description:
With `event`: what happened, in the language of `Accept-Language`, when the event has a
readable sentence; with `note`: the note.

id.description: Id of the audit entry.

sentence.description: What happened, as a sentence in the language of `Accept-Language`.

AddPasskeyRequest.description: The authenticator's answer to an add-passkey ceremony.

credential.description: The created credential as JSON (`credential.toJSON()` in the browser).

name.description: A name to recognize the passkey by, 1 to 100 characters.

ai_assisted.description: The text comes from an AI suggestion (shown with a label).

body.description: Plain text.

internal.description: `true`: an internal note only staff see.

mentions.description: Colleagues to notify, in an internal note (at most 20).

quantity.description: 1 to 1000; the add-on's limits count this many times.

Address.description: A postal address in an administrative unit (Vietnam: province and commune, since 2025-07-01).

commune_code.description: Code of the commune, ward or special zone (5 digits for Vietnam).

commune_name.description: Name of the commune when the address was written.

province_code.description: Code of the province (2 digits for Vietnam).

province_name.description: Name of the province when the address was written.

AddressInput.description: An address to check: codes only; names are filled in.

line.description: House number, street, village… (1 to 300 characters).

parent_code.description: Code of the province, for a commune.

valid_to.description: First day no longer in force; `null` while in force.

oneOf.description: The province, for a commune.

AdministrativeUnitDetail.description: An administrative unit with the unit above it.

AiStatus.description: What the AI features of this server can do now.

daily_token_limit.description: Daily token limit; 0 means no limit.

embedding_dimensions.description: Length of each embedding vector; 0 when off.

images.description: The model reads images (alt text suggestions work).

model.description: Model used for text; empty when off.

provider.description: `anthropic` or `openai` (the Chat Completions format); empty when off.

tokens_today.description: Tokens used today (UTC), text and embeddings together.

Alert.description: Something about the server that needs attention.

hint.description: What to do about it (a setting, a command), in English; `null` when the check gives none.

name.description: The check that found it, `<module>.<check>` (as in `autoxide doctor`).

severity.description:
`failed` (what depends on it does not work) or `warning` (works, but fix it before
running for real).

alerts.description: Failed ones first, then warnings; empty when everything is fine.

checked_at.description: When the checks ran (up to a minute ago; `refresh=true` runs them now).

AllowedTenantDomain.description: A domain that may get a TLS certificate.

AltRequest.description: What the alt text is for.

context.description:
Where the image is used (for example the title of the post), up to 500 characters; helps
the model say what matters.

locale.description: Language of the alt text, a BCP 47 code.

AltSuggestionResponse.description: A suggested alt text; nothing was saved.

alt.example: Xuan Huong lake in Da Lat at sunrise, with pine trees on the far shore.

decorative.description: The model thinks the image is purely decorative: leave its alt text empty.

AnswerResponse.description: One answer, with the field as it was when the submission was sent.

choices.description:
For `select`, `radio` and `checkbox`: the chosen options with their labels in the form
version the submission was sent with (in the order of `value`). A value no longer among
that version's options comes with an empty label. Absent for other types.

label.description: The field's label in the form version the submission was sent with.

value.description: A string; a number for `number`; an array of values for `checkbox`; `true` for `consent`.

ApiKeyResponse.description: An API key, without its secret.

expires_at.description: When the key stops working; `null`: never.

kind.description:
Who uses the key: `human` (you), `agent` (an AI agent: risky commands wait for a person's
approval) or `service` (another program). The audit log records it as `actor_kind`.

last_used_at.description: Last time the key was used, to the minute; `null`: never used.

org_id.description:
The organization unit the key is bound to: it acts only on data of this unit and the
units below it. The root unit (the id of the tenant) means no limit.

permissions.description:
Permissions the key may use, sorted by name. The key never has more than its
owner has at the moment of the request.

prefix.description:
A few characters of the key, to recognize it: `axk1_…` and the first 8 characters of the
key's random part (after the tenant part). Keys created in older versions (`axk_…`) show
their first 12 characters.

ApplyTagInput.description: Records to tag or untag in one call.

add.description: Records that get the tag (those that have it already are skipped).

skipped.description: Records left as they were: already tagged, untagged, at 50 tags, or not found.

ApprovalRequest.description: A command an AI agent asked to run, waiting for a person.

permissions.description: Any of these permissions may approve it.

reason.description: Why it was rejected.

requested_by.description: The user whose agent key asked.

url.description: Where to look at it and decide.

ApproveSupportMacroRequest.description: Approval of a saved reply for automatic answers.

enabled.description: `true`: you approve the exact text for automatic answers; `false`: stop using it.

questions.description: Ways customers ask the question, per language (1 to 50 in all).

review_due_on.description: Automatic use stops after this day unless approved again (today to one year ahead).

AssignRequest.description: Put a tenant on a plan.

addons.description: Replace the add-ons with these; leave out to keep them.

price_id.description:
An active recurring price of that plan; without it, periods last a month and nothing is
charged.

trial.description: Start with the plan's free trial when the tenant never had one; default `true`.

AuditEntryResponse.description: One change, as recorded in the audit log.

actor_api_key_id.description: API key used, when the change was made with one.

actor_kind.description:
Who made the change: `user` (a person, signed in or through an API key of kind `human`),
`agent` (an AI agent's API key), `service` (another program's API key), `support` (platform
staff through a support grant), `system` (command line, background jobs) or `public`
(someone not signed in, such as a visitor sending a form).

actor_name.description:
Display name of `actor_user_id`, with `include=actor`: `null` when the account no longer
exists; absent when no user made the change.

actor_user_id.description:
User who made the change; `null` for the system (command line, background jobs,
self-registration).

after.description: State after the change, when it applies.

before.description: State before the change, when it applies.

id.description: Id of the event that recorded the change; ids sort by time.

recorded_at.description: When the audit log recorded it (shortly after).

AuthorFields.description: Fields of an author profile. Omitted fields stay as they are.

avatar_media_id.description: Picture (a media item id); `null` removes it.

slug.description: Omitted or empty: made from the name.

user_id.description: Link the profile to a user account; `null` unlinks it.

entry_count.description: How many entries (in any status) list this author. Only in the list.

slug.description: Unique.

user_id.description: The user account behind the profile, if any.

reason.description: Why (required, 1 to 500 characters; for the records).

until.description: When it ends; omit for ever.

value.description: The user id, the email address, or the `ip_fingerprint` shown on a comment.

BillingPeriodResponse.description: A billing period of a subscription: what is charged for which time, and whether it is paid.

invoice_id.description:
The operator's invoice for the period (`GET /api/v1/invoices/documents/{id}` for the
operator), and its series and number.

kind.description:
`initial` (first period), `renewal`, `proration` (part of a period after an upgrade) or
`metered`.

provider_reference.description: The payment provider's reference (or the bank transfer's), when paid.

reference.description: Unique per tenant: `plans:<subscription_id>:<period start>:<kind>`.

BillingProfileRequest.description: The whole billing profile; it replaces the one there is.

oneOf.description: Address; names are filled in from the codes (`GET /api/v1/address/provinces`).

email.description: Where invoices and billing reminders go.

tax_code.description: Tax code: 10 digits, or 10 digits, `-` and 3 digits; leave out for a person without one.

BillingProfileResponse.description: Who the platform invoices: your tenant's legal details.

email.description: Where invoices and billing reminders go.

legal_name.description: Legal name of the business or person invoiced.

tax_code.description: Tax code (Vietnam: 10 digits, or 10 digits, a dash and 3 digits for a branch).

BodyMark.description:
A mark of a `text` node: `bold`, `italic`, `underline`, `strike`, `code`, or `link`
(`attrs.href`: `http://`, `https://`, `mailto:` or a path starting with `/`).

BodyNode.description:
A node of a body, in the ProseMirror / Tiptap JSON shape. The server accepts only these
`type`s (anything else is refused):

- blocks: `paragraph`, `heading` (`attrs.level` 2–4), `bulletList`, `orderedList`
  (`attrs.start`), `listItem`, `blockquote`, `codeBlock` (`attrs.language`; plain
  `text` only), `horizontalRule`, `image` (`attrs.mediaId` — a media item id — `alt`,
  `caption`; no `src`), `table`, `tableRow`, `tableHeader`, `tableCell` (`attrs.colspan`,
  `rowspan`, `colwidth`), `embed` (`attrs.url`, an `https://` address on an allowed host; or
  `attrs.kind` + `attrs.id`, a record of another module such as `catalog.product`, which must
  exist — public reads list it in `embeds`);
- inline: `text` (with `marks`), `hardBreak`.

The root is `{"type": "doc", "content": [...]}`.

attrs.description: Attributes; only those listed for the type.

BookingAvailability.description: Free times of a service, with what the customer must know before booking.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the unit, e.g. `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh`.

BookingCheckout.description: Where the customer pays the deposit.

checkout_url.description: Partner page where the customer pays.

expires_at.description: Pay before this moment, or the place is released.

qr_payload.description: QR code payload, when the partner gives one.

challenge_id.description: Send it back with the code.

expires_at.description: The code works until this moment, once.

BookingCreated.description: A booking just made, with the deposit checkout when one is due.

oneOf.description: Present when the booking is `held`: send the customer here to pay the deposit.

user_id.description: The customer's account, for signed-in customers.

phone.description: Phone number, e.g. `0912345678` or `+84912345678`; stored as E.164.

BookingDeposit.description: How much deposit a booking asks for, paid through the shop's payment partner.

kind.description: `none`, `percent` (of the price) or `amount` (fixed, in the price's currency).

value.description: Percent 1–100, or the amount in minor units; `0` for `none`.

BookingDepositState.description: A deposit and where it stands.

refund.description: The part given back (or being given back).

status.description:
`none`, `pending` (waiting for the payment), `paid`, `refund_pending`, `refunded` or `retained`
(kept by the policy).

BookingException.description: Time off or extra working hours.

local_start.description: `starts_at` in the local time of the unit, with its offset, e.g. `2026-11-23T09:00:00+07:00`.

resource_id.description: The staff member (or court, room…) free at this time.

BookingPhoneCode.description: A one-time code sent by SMS, to prove a guest owns the phone number.

code.description: The 6 digits received by SMS.

hold_expires_at.description: Until when a `held` booking waits for the deposit.

org_id.description: The unit (shop, branch) of the staff member.

resource_id.description: The staff member (or court, room…) booked.

status.description:
`held` (waiting for the deposit), `pending` (waiting for the shop), `confirmed`, `checked_in`,
`completed`, `cancelled`, `no_show` or `expired` (the deposit was not paid in time).

BookingResource.description: A staff member, room or equipment.

BookingSchedule.description: The weekly schedule of a resource.

BookingWeeklyRange.description: A weekly working range, in the local time of the unit (setting `organizations.timezone`).

end_minute.description: Minutes after local midnight, up to 1440: 1020 is 17:00.

start_minute.description: Minutes after local midnight, in steps of 5: 540 is 09:00.

suppressed.description: The address is (now or already) suppressed.

BounceRequest.description: A bounce or complaint reported by a mail service.

email.description: The address that bounced.

reason.description: What the mail service said (kept as the note of a suppression), up to 255 characters.

BulkPreview.description: What a bulk request would act on.

BulkRequest.description: Records to act on: either `ids`, or `filter` with `expected_count`.

dry_run.description:
`true`: only say which records would be acted on (`200` with `count` and `ids`); nothing is
queued or changed.

expected_count.description: How many records the caller saw matching `filter`; required with it, unless `dry_run`.

filter.description: Filters of the list (see `x-autoxide-filters`): every matching record.

CallbackRequest.description: What the provider sent back to `redirect_uri`.

code.description: The `code` query parameter.

CampaignPreviewResponse.description: A campaign mail exactly as subscribers get it.

body_html.description:
The HTML body with the preheader and the footer; `null` for a text-only campaign. Show it
only inside a sandboxed `<iframe sandbox>`, like `body_html`.

body_text.description: The plain-text body with the footer (list name, preferences link, postal address).

subject.description: The subject, with the advertising label when the campaign is advertising.

CampaignResponse.description: A campaign: one mail sent to the confirmed subscribers of a list.

advertising.description:
Advertising: the subject gets `AUTOXIDE_NEWSLETTER_ADVERTISING_LABEL` and each address
gets at most `AUTOXIDE_NEWSLETTER_ADVERTISING_MAX_PER_DAY` such mails a day.

body_html.description:
HTML body, if any; stored and sent as is, NOT sanitised. An admin interface must
show it only inside a sandboxed `<iframe sandbox>` (no scripts, no same origin), never
inserted into its own page.

format.description: `static` (sent as written) or `template` (subject and bodies rendered for each recipient).

locale.description: Language of the footer added to every mail.

preheader.description: Short text shown after the subject in some mail apps (HTML mails only).

source.description: Where an automatic campaign came from (`content.entry` for a new post).

limit.description: With `quota_exceeded`: the limit, how much is used and the most allowed.

reason.description:
Why not: `unknown_permission`, `module_not_enabled` (the tenant's plan does not include the
module), `feature_not_in_plan`, `quota_exceeded` or `missing_permission` (none of your
roles grants it at this unit).

required_feature.description: With `feature_not_in_plan`: the feature the plan must include.

required_module.description: With `module_not_enabled`: the module the plan must include.

upgrade_to.description: With a plan reason: codes of the plans on sale that would allow it (empty when unknown).

CanCheck.description: One question: may I use `permission` at `org_id`?

feature.description: A plan feature the action needs (as a navigation item's `required_feature`), e.g. `shop.pos`.

limit.description: A counted limit the action uses one more of, e.g. `kernel.custom_fields`.

org_id.description: The organization unit; omitted: the whole tenant.

reason.description: Up to 200 characters.

at_period_end.description:
`true` (default): cancel when the current period ends, and keep using it until then;
`false`: cancel now (data becomes read-only and is kept for the plan's retention days).

Catalog.description: The triggers and actions you may use in rules.

CatalogAddPrices.description: Prices to add to a price list.

reference.description:
Your code for this change (1 to 100 visible ASCII characters): the same reference and
content again returns the rows written the first time instead of adding them twice.

warnings.description: Prices below a `warn` price floor; they were saved.

CatalogAttribute.description: An attribute products can have (origin, material, size of the box…).

legal_basis.description: Law the attribute comes from, for legally required label contents.

CatalogAttributeOption.description: A choosable value of an `option` / `options` attribute.

code.description: 1 to 64 lower-case letters, digits, `_` or `-`; unique in the attribute.

CatalogAttributeOptions.description: The whole set of options of an attribute.

options.description: Up to 500 options, in display order. Options are matched by `code`.

CatalogAttributeValue.description: A value of an attribute on a product.

value.description:
By the attribute's type: text, a whole number, a decimal written as text (`"12.5"`),
`true` / `false`, a date `YYYY-MM-DD`, an option code, or a list of option codes.

CatalogCategory.description: A category of the tenant's tree.

position.description: Display order among siblings.

applies_to_descendants.description: Also for products of the subcategories.

effective_from.description: The rule applies from this day (e.g. when a new labelling rule takes effect).

effective_to.description: The rule stops applying on this day.

required.description: Products in the category cannot go on sale without a value.

CatalogCategoryAttributes.description: The whole set of attributes of a category.

CatalogCategoryRestrictions.description: The restricted-goods rules linked to a category.

CatalogCategoryText.description: Name and slug of a category in one language.

slug.description: Omitted: made from the name. Unique per language in the tenant.

quantity.description: Units of the component in one bundle, 1 to 10000.

CatalogComponents.description: The whole set of components of a bundle variant.

code.description:
1 to 64 lower-case letters, digits or `_`; unique in the tenant
(`catalog.attribute_code_taken`).

scale.description: Decimal places of a `decimal` attribute, 0 to 6. Default 0.

parent_id.description: Omitted: a top category. Categories nest at most 7 levels deep.

position.description: Display order among siblings; omitted: last.

texts.description: Name and slug per language, e.g. `{"en": {"name": "Shirts"}}`.

document_type.description: A document type a rule requires, e.g. `alcohol_retail_licence`.

file_key.description: Key of a scanned file already stored.

operation.description:
`set` (the new price is `value`), `percent` (`value` in basis points, signed: `-1000` =
10% off) or `amount` (`value` minor units added, signed).

valid_from.description: When the new prices start; omitted: now. A future time schedules them.

category_id.description: Only products in this category or below.

min_margin_bp.description: Lowest margin over unit cost, in basis points (`1500` = 15%), 0 to 100000.

oneOf.description: Lowest allowed price.

adjust_bp.description: Adjustment of a derived list in basis points, signed (`-1500` = 15% off), -10000 to 100000.

adjust_minor.description: Amount added after the percentage, in minor units, signed.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code. Consumer prices in Viet Nam must be `VND`.

customer_group.description: Only for this customer group (a free code until customer groups exist, step 47).

derived_from.description:
Make a derived list: its prices are written from this source list (which cannot itself be
derived; `catalog.derived_chain`), adjusted and rounded. Same currency as the source.

org_id.description: The store or chain unit; prices apply there and below. Omit when you work in one unit.

priority.description: Higher wins among lists that tie on unit and filters. Default 0.

rounding_rule_id.description: Rounding rule of a derived list (`GET /rounding-rules`).

tax_inclusive.description: Prices include tax; consumer prices in Viet Nam must.

category_ids.description: Categories of the product; the first is the main one.

kind.description:
Kind of product: `physical` (shipped, stocked), `digital` (downloaded), `service` (not
shipped), `bundle` (takes stock from each component).

locale.description: Language of `text`; becomes the default language of the product.

The organization unit that owns the product; you need `catalog.products.write` there.

tax_category.description: Tax category code of the tax engine, e.g. `vat.standard` (`GET /api/v1/tax/categories`).

text.description: Texts of a product in one language.

Plain text up to 50000 characters; blank lines separate paragraphs and clients may render
minimal Markdown. HTML is not interpreted.

tenant (`catalog.slug_taken`).

Barcode (GTIN or own code), up to 32 letters, digits or `-`; GTIN-8/12/13/14 must have a

option_value_ids.description: One value id of each option of the product; empty when the product has no options.

Expected availability date of a pre-order, after today

preorder_ends_at.description: Pre-orders stop being taken at this time.

preorder_limit.description: Total pre-order units, above 0 (`catalog.preorder_limit_invalid`); omitted: no limit.

preorder_messages.description: Public pre-order note per language, e.g. `{"en": "Ships from 15 December"}`.

Stock keeping unit, 1 to 64 characters; unique in the tenant ignoring case and spaces
(`catalog.sku_taken`).

weight_grams.description: Shipping weight in grams (physical products and bundles).

warranty_months.description: Warranty in months, 1 to 600; omitted: no warranty.

ending_minor.description: Ending in minor units, 0 or more and below `step_minor`, e.g. `9000`.

step_minor.description: Step in minor units, above 0, e.g. `10000`.

CatalogKind.description:
Kind of product: `physical` (shipped, stocked), `digital` (downloaded), `service` (not
shipped), `bundle` (takes stock from each component).

parent_id.description: New parent; `null` makes it a top category.

CatalogOption.description: An option of a product, e.g. colour or size.

id.description: Keep the id of an existing option; omit for a new one.

CatalogOptionValue.description: A value of an option, e.g. "Red".

id.description: Keep the id of an existing value so variants keep pointing at it; omit for a new value.

CatalogOptions.description: The whole set of options of a product.

options.description: Up to 3 options, each with 1 to 100 values.

source.description: `manual`, `derived`, `bulk` or `import`.

valid_to.description: End of a temporary change; the earlier prices apply again after it.

value.description: New price (`set`), basis points (`percent`, signed) or minor units added (`amount`, signed).

Which variants a bulk change covers: the union of the categories (with their subcategories),
products and variants listed. All empty: every variant with a price in the list.

min_margin_bp.description: Minimum margin over unit cost, in basis points (`1500` = 15%).

allOf.description: In the currency of the list, not negative.

compare_at.description: Struck-through price, higher than `amount`; display only.

oneOf.description:
A sum of money: an integer number of the currency's minor units (cents for `USD`, dong for
`VND`) plus the currency.

amount.description:
Amount in minor units of `currency`, as a base-10 integer string (JSON numbers above
2^53 lose precision in JavaScript). `"1999"` with `USD` is 19.99 US dollars; negative
amounts start with `-`.

valid_from.description: When the price starts; omitted: now. A future time schedules the price.

valid_to.description: End of a temporary price; the earlier price applies again after it.

derived_from.description: Source list of a derived list.

org_id.description: The store or chain unit the list applies to (and every unit below it).

priority.description: Higher wins among lists that tie on unit and filters.

`missing_attributes`, `missing_documents`, `restricted`).

media.description: Up to 50 images, in display order.

name.description: Name in the product's default language.

value.description:

data.description: A role: a named set of permissions given to users.

data.description: An automation rule: "when the trigger happens and the conditions hold, run the actions".

A tree of `all` / `any` / `not` over comparisons `{"field": "event.total", "op": "gt",

"schedule", "every": "hour" | "day" | "week", "weekday", "hour", "minute", "timezone"}`,
`{"type": "manual"}` or `{"type": "metric", "metric", "operator", "value", "currency",
"hour", "minute", "timezone"}`. See `GET /api/v1/automations/catalog`.

Law on Artificial Intelligence 134/2025/QH15, from 2026-03-01).

The content was generated by AI. Show readers a notice when your rules (for example
Article 50 of the EU AI Act) ask for one.

A person reviewed the AI-generated content and took editorial responsibility when it
was published. Always `false` when `ai_generated` is `false`.

node carries its own.

were when the entry was published.

Records of other modules embedded in `body` (nodes `embed` with `kind` and `id`, e.g. a
product), keyed by `<kind>:<id>`, in the entry's language. A record that is not public
(any more) is left out: skip its node. Prices and stock are not here — read them from the
owning module's public API, so they are always current.

A tree of `all` / `any` / `not` over comparisons `{"field": "event.total", "op": "gt",
"value": 5000000}` (`op`: eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, contains, exists); `null`: always.

next_run_at.description: When the schedule or metric check runs next.

run_as.description:
The actions run with the current permissions of this user: the author, or whoever enabled
the rule last.

`active`, `disabled`, `pending_approval` (made by an AI agent: a person must enable it) or
`paused` (stopped by itself; see `status_reason`).

trigger.description:
What starts a run: `{"type": "event", "event": "<module>.<event>"}`, `{"type":
"schedule", "every": "hour" | "day" | "week", "weekday", "hour", "minute", "timezone"}`,
`{"type": "manual"}` or `{"type": "metric", "metric", "operator", "value", "currency",
"hour", "minute", "timezone"}`. See `GET /api/v1/automations/catalog`.

version.description: Raised by one on every change of the rule; each run records the version it used.

cursor.description: The next step to run, from 0.

depth.description:
1 for a run started by a person, a schedule or an ordinary event; one more for each rule
in a chain (a rule's action caused the event of the next rule).

org_id.description: The unit of the rule.

rule_version.description:

started).

status.description:

rows.description: Rows that move or are copied.

message.

The fields (`title`, `slug`, `excerpt`, `body`, media, SEO). Only when reading one

RoleCountResponse.description: How many people hold one role.

members.description:
People holding the role, at any unit; each person once. List them with
`GET /api/v1/auth/memberships?role_id=…`.

scope.description:
How far a permission reaches in the organization tree, from the unit of the membership:

it), `tenant` (the whole tenant).

grants.description:

items.description: A permission a role grants, with how far it reaches in the organization tree.

scope.description:
How far a permission reaches in the organization tree, from the unit of the membership:
`own` (records the person owns), `unit` (that unit), `subtree` (that unit and every unit below
it), `tenant` (the whole tenant).

name.description: Unique. Lowercase letters, digits, `_` and `-`, starting with a letter.

permissions.description:
Permissions to grant; each must be listed by `GET /api/v1/auth/permissions`.
Duplicates are ignored.

requires_mfa.description:
When `true`, the role's permissions work only for accounts with two-step sign-in
(an authenticator app or a passkey); others see `mfa_required` in `GET /api/v1/auth/me`
until they turn it on. The only change the built-in `admin` role accepts.

RoleResponse.description: A role: a named set of permissions given to users.

all_permissions.description:
`true` only for the built-in `admin` role: it grants every permission,
including permissions added later, and cannot be changed (except `requires_mfa`) or
deleted.

grants.description:
The same permissions with their scope in the organization tree. Empty when
`all_permissions`.

permissions.description: Permissions the role grants, sorted by name. Empty when `all_permissions`.

requires_mfa.description: `true`: the role's permissions work only for accounts with two-step sign-in.

RuleResponse.description: An automation rule: "when the trigger happens and the conditions hold, run the actions".

conditions.description:
A tree of `all` / `any` / `not` over comparisons `{"field": "event.total", "op": "gt",
"value": 5000000}` (`op`: eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, contains, exists); `null`: always.

next_run_at.description: When the schedule or metric check runs next.

org_id.description: The organization unit the rule belongs to; the root unit has the id of the tenant.

run_as.description:
The actions run with the current permissions of this user: the author, or whoever enabled
the rule last.

status.description:
`active`, `disabled`, `pending_approval` (made by an AI agent: a person must enable it) or
`paused` (stopped by itself; see `status_reason`).

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the schedule.

trigger.description:
What starts a run: `{"type": "event", "event": "<module>.<event>"}`, `{"type":
"schedule", "every": "hour" | "day" | "week", "weekday", "hour", "minute", "timezone"}`,
`{"type": "manual"}` or `{"type": "metric", "metric", "operator", "value", "currency",
"hour", "minute", "timezone"}`. See `GET /api/v1/automations/catalog`.

version.description: Raised by one on every change of the rule; each run records the version it used.

context.description: The data of the trigger, as the templates see it: `event`, `trigger`.

cursor.description: The next step to run, from 0.

depth.description:
1 for a run started by a person, a schedule or an ordinary event; one more for each rule
in a chain (a rule's action caused the event of the next rule).

org_id.description: The unit of the rule.

rule_version.description:
The version of the rule the run uses (changing the rule does not change runs already
started).

status.description:
`queued`, `running`, `waiting` (a `wait` step), `awaiting_approval` (a risky step waits for
a person), `succeeded`, `failed` or `skipped` (not run, see `error_code`).

input.description: What the templates see as `event` (e.g. `{"order": {"id": "…"}}`); default `{}`.

`content.list_content_entries`.

one search.

the words matched.

term_ids.description: Up to 5 existing categories or tags of the entry's language that fit; never new ones.

tokens.

reverse proxy when it is set up for it (`AUTOXIDE_AUTH_COUNTRY_HEADER`); `null` when not
known. The IP address is never kept.

none was sent.

right input; `null` when the module does not say. The server checks every value anyway.

order_by.description: Order before this time to make today's dispatch.

rates.description: Weight tiers (only in `GET /methods/{id}` and after changes).

Fields of a shipping method. On create `code`, `kind`, `names` and `currency` are required;
on change, leave out what stays (`code`, `kind`, `org_id`, `currency` cannot change).

auto_book.description:
`carrier` methods: book the carrier as soon as an order asks for a shipment (default off:
staff check the goods first).

calendar_id.description: Delivery calendar (working days, holidays, cut-off times).

carrier_account_id.description: `carrier` methods: the carrier account quoting the fee.

code.description: Stable code, lower-case letters, digits and `-`, e.g. `standard`.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of every amount of the method, e.g. `VND`.

cutoff_minute.description: Orders before this minute of the day (calendar time zone; 660 = 11:00) leave the same day.

`table_rate` methods: weight of an item that has none, in grams; `null`: such items make the
method unavailable (`shipping.weight_missing`).

hold_days.description: `pickup` methods: days the parcel waits for the buyer.

names.description: Name per language, e.g. `{"vi": "Giao tieu chuan", "en": "Standard"}`.

the same `code`.

position.description: Display order, smaller first.

same_day.description: Delivered the same day when ordered before the cut-off.

service_code.description: `carrier` methods: the carrier's service code; `null` for every service.

tax_category.description: Tax category of the shipping fee in the tax engine, default `vat.standard`.

volumetric_divisor.description: Volumetric divisor: volumetric grams = length × width × height (mm³) / divisor. Default 6000.

a carrier account quotes), `pickup` (collect in store).

amount.description: Fee the buyer pays, VAT included; zero when free.

estimated_days.description: Days, as declared by the method: `[min, max]`.

oneOf.description: Free from this order value.

hold_days.description: Store pickup: days the parcel waits.

option_key.description:
Send back when placing the order; a different fee or destination answers
`shipping.option_changed`.

ready_at.description: Store pickup: when the order is ready.

tax_category.description: Tax category of the fee (VAT line on the invoice).

items.description: Order line keys packed in this parcel; lines not listed go in the first parcel.

instructions.description: Shown to the buyer, e.g. where to park.

org_id.description: The store: the method's unit or a unit below it.

prep_hours.description: Hours to get the order ready (0 to 720).

administrative units (`GET /api/v1/address/provinces`). Elsewhere: `province_code` is the
region (state, province…), `city` the city, with an optional `postal_code`.

commune_code.description: Vietnam: code of the commune, ward or special zone (required).

line.description: House number, street, village… (1 to 300 characters).

postal_code.description: Postal code, mostly for addresses outside Vietnam.

province_code.description: Vietnam: code of the province. Elsewhere: the region.

options.description: Cheapest first; empty when nothing in the cart needs shipping.

requires_shipping.description: `false` for digital goods and services: not weighed, not shipped.

oneOf.description: Where to deliver; leave out for store pickup only.

order_value.description: Order value after discounts, for free shipping.

org_id.description: The selling store; methods of the units above it apply too.

max_side_mm.description: Longest side allowed, in mm; `null` for any size.

max_weight_grams.description: …up to, not including, this weight; `null` for no upper limit.

min_weight_grams.description: The tier applies from this chargeable weight (grams)…

ShippingRates.description: The full list of weight tiers of a method.

ShippingRegion.description: One region of a zone: a country, or one province of it.

province_code.description:
Code of the province; `null` for the whole country. A zone listing the province of the
destination wins over a zone for the whole country.

ShippingRequestItem.description: One line of a shipment request.

ShippingShipment.description: A shipment with its parcels, items and tracking history.

ShippingShipmentSummary.description: A shipment without its parcels, items and history.

last_error_code.description: Last refusal of the carrier when booking (`shipping.carrier_error`…).

ShippingSplitRequest.description: Lines to move to a new shipment: order line key → quantity.

ShippingStatus.description: Common status of a shipment, mapped from each carrier's own statuses.

ShippingTrackingEvent.description: A step of the tracking history (only added, never changed).

source.description: `carrier`, `staff` or `system`.

ShippingUnavailableMethod.description: A method that cannot ship this cart, and why.

ShippingZoneChanges.description: Changes of a zone; leave out what stays.

ShippingZoneRegions.description: The full list of regions of a zone.

auto_children_limit.description: How many sub-items `auto_children` takes, 1 to 50; default 12.

children.description: Sub-items. Menus nest at most 4 levels and hold at most 200 items in all.

oneOf.description: An object to feature in the item's drop-down panel (title, summary, link, picture).

id.description:
The item's id from the menu as read, to keep it across this save (the response of
`PUT` shows the same id). Leave it out for a new item, and when creating a menu.

label.description:
Up to 200 characters. Needed unless `ref` is given; empty with `ref` shows the title of
the object, in the menu's language.

oneOf.description:
The object to link to. It must exist; the public menu leaves the item out (with its
sub-items) while the object is not public.

url.description: An `https://`, `http://` or `mailto:` address, or a path starting with a single `/`.

item_count.description: How many items the menu holds, at every level.

org_id.description: The website (organization unit) of the menu.

updated_by.description:
Who created the menu or last replaced its items; `null` when unknown (menus saved
before this field existed, or changed by the system).

noindex.description: Leave it out of the sitemap when `true`.

translations.description: The other languages of the same entry, for `hreflang` alternates.

StartMediaUploadRequest.description: A media item to upload straight to storage.

content_type.description:
The real media type of the file; the upload link only accepts this `Content-Type`, and the
content is checked against it when you complete the upload.

folder_id.description: Folder to put the item in. Omit for the root.

name.description: File name, 1 to 255 characters, without `/` or `\`.

org_id.description:
The organization unit that owns the item; you need `media.write` there. Omit when you work
in one unit only (or for the whole tenant).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the content, as 64 hex digits.

tags.description: Tags for the item (each 1 to 50 characters, at most 20).

StartPasskeyRegistrationRequest.description: Proof that you are the account owner.

current_password.description: Your current password: a stolen access token alone must not add a passkey.

reauth_token.description:
A confirmation token from `POST /api/v1/auth/me/reauth`, instead of `current_password`
(accounts without a password use this). Exactly one of the two.

StartRequest.description: Where the interface wants the provider to send the browser back.

redirect_uri.description: A page of the interface, exactly as listed in the provider's `redirect_uris`.

authorization_url.description:
Open this address in the browser. The provider comes back to `redirect_uri` with `code`
and `state` in the query.

expires_in.description: Seconds left to finish; after that, start again.

reauth_token.description:
A confirmation token from `POST /api/v1/auth/me/reauth`, instead of `current_password`
(accounts without a password use this). Exactly one of the two.

StartUploadRequest.description: A file to upload straight to storage.

content_type.description: Media type of the file; the upload link only accepts this `Content-Type`.

name.description: File name, 1 to 255 characters, without `/` or `\`.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the content, as 64 hex digits; checked when you complete the upload.

size.description: Exact size in bytes; the link only accepts this size.

Status.description: Where an entry is in its life.

StepLog.description: One step in the log of a run.

approved_by.description: Who approved the step, when it needed approval.

idempotency_key.description: `automation:<run id>:<step>`: calling again never does the step twice.

index.description: Position of the action in the rule, from 0.

result.description: The tool's result (cut down when large).

SubmissionCounts.description: Submissions of a form by status.

answers.description: The answers in the order of the form version, with their labels.

consent.description:
Proof of consent when the form has a `consent` field: `{text, version, at, source,
field, ip_fingerprint}` — the exact text shown, the form version, when.

data.description: The answers, by field key.

email.description: The sender's email address (lower case), when the form asks for one.

form_version.description: The form version (of its fields) the submission was sent with.

ip_fingerprint.description:
Keyed hash of the sender's network block (never the address itself); cleared after
`AUTOXIDE_FORMS_IP_RETENTION_DAYS`.

page_url.description: Page the form was sent from.

referrer.description: Page that led the sender to the form, when the website sends it.

spam_reason.description:
Why the anti-spam checks held it (`too_fast`, `duplicate`, `classifier`…, joined by
commas); `null` unless `spam`.

SubmissionStatus.description: Where a submission is in the inbox.

SubmitRequest.description: A submission of a public form.

challenge.description: The value of the `altcha` widget, when the server uses a challenge.

data.description:
Answers by field key: a string for most types, a number for `number`, an array of
option values for `checkbox`, `true` for a ticked `consent`. Omit (or send `""` /
`null`) unanswered fields. Unknown keys are refused.

form_token.description:
Token from `GET /api/v1/antispam/token?scope=forms:<key>`; needed unless the caller
has the permission `forms.submit` (a website server with its own API key). Being
signed in without it is not enough.

locale.description: Language the form was shown in: `en` or `vi`.

page_url.description: Address of the page the form is on; omitted: the `Referer` header.

referrer.description: Page that led the visitor there (`document.referrer`), if any.

trap.description: The hidden trap field: people leave it empty.

id.description: Id of the submission. Sending the same form token again returns the same id.

message.description: The form's success message, in the language sent.

challenge.description: The value of the `altcha` widget, when the server uses a challenge.

consent_text.description: The exact consent text shown next to the form (kept as proof), up to 2000 characters.

consent_version.description: Version of that text, if you keep versions.

form_token.description:
Token from `GET /api/v1/antispam/token?scope=newsletter:subscribe`; needed unless the
caller has the permission `newsletter.subscribe` (a website server with its own API
key). Being signed in without it is not enough.

locale.description: Language of the confirmation mail: `en` or `vi`.

name.description: Up to 200 characters. Never put in the confirmation mail.

source.description: Where the form is (kept with the consent), e.g. `footer`; up to 100 characters.

trap.description: The hidden trap field: people leave it empty.

SubscribeResponse.description: The answer to a sign-up: always the same.

accepted.description: Always `true`. Tell the visitor to check their inbox if a list needs confirming.

email.description: In lower case.

soft_bounces.description: Soft bounces since the address was last taken off the suppression list.

suppressed.description:
Why the address is on the suppression list (`hard_bounce`, `soft_bounce`, `complaint`,
`manual`); `null`: it is not.

SubscriberStatus.description: Whether a subscriber may get mail at all.

SubscriptionResponse.description: A subscription of a subscriber to one list.

consent.description: Proof of consent: `{text, version, at, source, ip_fingerprint}` as recorded.

hold_reason.description: Why the anti-spam checks held the sign-up (it then needed confirming by mail).

SubscriptionStatus.description: Where a subscriber stands on one list.

by_currency.description: Sums per original currency; money of two currencies is never added together.

oneOf.description: All amounts converted to the asked `currency` and added, when you asked for one.

key.description:
The group: a day `YYYY-MM-DD` (first day of the week or month), a tenant id or a unit id;
`total` for the totals.

SummaryResponse.description: Sums of one fact kind over a period.

missing_rates.description: Amounts in these currencies on these days had no rate and are not in `converted`.

incomplete.description: Figures that did not answer in time or failed.

SupportAllowedResponse.description: Whether a tenant lets platform staff in for support.

support_access.description:
The tenant's setting `auth.support_access`: `false` means only a `legal_request` grant can
be made (a `support` one is refused with `auth.support_access_disabled`).

source.description: `macro` or `fact`.

SupportAutoReplyDecision.description: What an automatic answer would do.

outcome.description:
`send` (answer automatically), `draft` (staff answer, a draft is prepared) or `handoff`
(staff answer).

source.description: `macro` or `fact`.

text.description: The exact text that would be sent.

SupportEscalation.description: Where to hand a ticket over.

basis.description:
`support` (the tenant must allow it with the setting `auth.support_access`) or
`legal_request` (a request of a competent authority; needs `legal_reference`).

legal_reference.description: For `legal_request`: number of the authority's document.

reason.description: Why, 10 to 500 characters; the tenant sees it.

role_id.description: A role of the platform tenant: its permissions apply in the tenant, at its root unit.

staff_user_id.description: A staff account of the platform tenant.

SupportGrantResponse.description: A time-limited access of platform staff to a tenant's data.

basis.description:
`support`, or `legal_request` (a request of a competent authority; the tenant cannot
revoke it).

first_used_at.description: When the staff first entered under it; `null`: not used.

legal_reference.description: Number of the authority's document, for `legal_request`.

role_id.description: The role of the platform tenant whose permissions they get.

staff_name.description:
Display name of that staff member, so the tenant knows who may enter; `null` when the
account no longer exists.

tenant_id.description: The tenant the staff may enter.

SupportHandoffRequest.description: The ticket token of a guest (empty for signed-in customers).

SupportMacro.description: A saved reply staff insert into answers.

org_id.description: The unit it belongs to; units below use it too.

questions.description: Ways customers ask the question, per language (automatic answers).

review_due_on.description: Automatic use stops after this day unless reviewed again (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

SupportMessage.description:
One message of a ticket. Messages are never edited; a hidden message keeps its place with
`hidden: true` (staff still see its text and the reason).

ai_assisted.description: Written from an AI suggestion (label it).

author_user_id.description: The account that wrote it (staff or customer); empty for guests and the server.

auto_reply.description: Sent automatically from an approved answer (label it "Automatic answer").

body.description: Plain text as written. For `system` messages: a line key such as `status:solved`.

body_html.description:
The same text as safe HTML (escaped, line breaks as `
`).

mentions.description: Colleagues mentioned in an internal note.

access_token.description: Guests only, shown only here: send it as `token` to the `/public/tickets/{id}` endpoints.

SupportOpenedTicket.description: A ticket just opened. Guests get `access_token` once: keep it to see and answer the ticket.

SupportPolicy.description:
Support policy of an organization unit. Units without their own policy use the nearest unit
above that has one, else the defaults.

auto_close_days.description: A solved ticket closes after this many days without a new message (1 to 90).

auto_reply.description: Automatic answers to simple questions (off by default).

auto_reply_blocked_terms.description: Words that always stop an automatic answer.

auto_reply_max_per_thread.description: At most this many automatic answers in a row on one ticket, then a person takes over.

auto_reply_min_confidence_bp.description: Lowest confidence (basis points, 0 to 10000) of the classification to answer automatically.

categories.description: Ticket categories customers choose from (codes; labels are translated by the website).

first_response_minutes.description: Business minutes to the first answer, per priority (`low`, `normal`, `high`, `urgent`).

inbound_email.description: Email replies to ticket notifications go back into the ticket (needs an inbound mail module).

resolve_minutes.description:
Business minutes to solve the ticket, per priority; time waiting for the customer does not
count.

utc_offset_minutes.description: Offset of the unit's local time from UTC, in minutes (Vietnam: 420).

defined_at.description: The unit whose own policy applies; empty: the defaults.

org_id.description: The unit asked about.

SupportPolicyInForce.description: The policy in force at a unit, and where it comes from.

SupportReplyDraft.description: A draft answer staff review before sending. Never sent by itself.

ai_assisted.description: Written by AI: send it with `ai_assisted: true` so it is labelled.

SupportReport.description: Support figures for tickets created in a period.

breached.description: Of those, that missed a response-time target.

median_first_response_minutes.description: Median minutes from opening to the first answer (wall clock), of answered tickets.

median_resolve_minutes.description: Median minutes from opening to solved (wall clock), of solved tickets.

SupportRequester.description: Who asked. Customers and guests see their own email or phone number masked.

user_id.description: The customer account, when the ticket belongs to one.

verified.description: The guest proved the email or phone number (accounts always count as verified).

SupportRequesterInput.description: Who asked, for a ticket staff open on behalf of a customer: exactly one of the three.

SupportRoutingRule.description: A routing rule: new tickets of the unit (and the units below) that match go to the team.

category.description: Only tickets of this category; empty: any.

oneOf.description: Only tickets from this channel; empty: any.

position.description: Rules of one unit are tried in this order; rules of nearer units first.

SupportTeam.description: A support team of an organization unit; it covers tickets of the unit and the units below.

SupportTeamMember.description: A member of a support team.

accepting.description: Takes new tickets in round-robin assignment.

case_id.description: The consumer complaint this ticket became (module `compliance`).

escalated_to_platform.description: Handed over to the marketplace operator.

first_response_due_at.description: Answer the customer before this (business hours of the unit).

follow_up_of.description: The earlier ticket this one follows up.

org_id.description: The organization unit (shop, marketplace store) the ticket belongs to.

oneOf.description: How the ticket ended; set once solved or closed.

resolve_due_at.description: Solve the ticket before this; the clock stops while waiting for the customer.

satisfaction.description: Customer rating after the ticket was solved, 1 to 5.

links.description: Linked records, as `<module>.<type>:<id>` (staff only; empty for customers).

SupportTicketDetail.description: A ticket with its messages, oldest first.

SupportWorkingHours.description: One range of working time on a day of the week.

SuppressionResponse.description: An address that gets no campaign mail.

note.description: A note, or the SMTP code of a bounce.

reason.description: `hard_bounce`, `soft_bounce`, `complaint` or `manual`.
Why, 1 to 500 characters (kept in the audit trail).

TagChanges.description: Changes to a tag; omitted fields stay.

description.description: `""` clears it.

TagRef.description: A tag, as attached to a record.

TagResponse.description: A tag. Items carry tags as names; tags are created when first given to an item.

item_count.description: Number of items (not in the trash) with this tag.

TargetRequest.description: A new comment state for a target. Omitted fields stay as they are.

closes_at.description: Close by itself from then on; `null` removes it.

hidden.description: `true` hides every comment of the target from everyone (and closes it).

TargetState.description: How the object of a menu item stands now.

exempt.description: `true`: not subject to this tax (shown as such on the invoice, not as 0%).

rate_percent.description: Rate in percent as a decimal string, e.g. `"8"`; `"0"` for a per-unit or exempt tax.

TaxInvoiceType.description: Kind of invoice the seller issues.

pack_code.description: The data pack it comes from, and its version.

TaxPackRequest.description: A tax data pack to import.

pack.description:
The pack, in the format of `modules/tax/packs/vn.json`: `code`, `version`, `checked_on`,
`source_note`, `jurisdictions`, `categories`, `rates`, `withholding_rates`, `rules`.

checked_on.description: Day its sources were last checked.

TaxPriceMode.description: Whether the line amounts include the taxes.

TaxProfile.description: Tax profile of an organization unit.

oneOf.description: Estimated revenue a year, for thresholds (cash register invoices).

org_id.description: The unit the profile is set on (the unit asked about, or the nearest one above it).

regime.description:
`vat_credit` (VAT by credit), `vat_direct` (VAT on revenue), `household` (household
business) or `exempt`.

tax_code.description:
Tax code: 10 or 13 digits (`0101234567-001` for a branch), or a 12-digit personal id used
as tax code.

TaxProfileRequest.description: The whole tax profile of a unit.

oneOf.description: Address; names are filled in from the codes.
Estimated revenue a year (thresholds such as cash register invoices).

tax_code.description:
10 or 13 digits (`0101234567-001` for a branch), or a 12-digit personal id used as tax
code.

own.description: `true` when the profile is the unit's own; `false` when it comes from a unit above.

TaxProfileResponse.description: The tax profile that applies to a unit.

snapshot.description: What was used (rates and their ids, pack version, rounding): keep it with the document.

oneOf.description: `consumer` (default) or `business`.

price_mode.description: `exclusive`: amounts are before taxes; `inclusive`: they include them.

seller_org_id.description:
The selling unit; default the tenant's root. Its tax profile (or the nearest above) decides
the regime; without one the seller declares VAT by credit.

tax_point.description: Day the tax applies (`YYYY-MM-DD`, in the seller's time zone).

TaxRateResponse.description: A tax rate with its dates.

effective_to.description: First day no longer in force; `null` while in force.

legal_basis.description: Legal basis (check it against the original document before production use).

stage.description: Order the taxes apply in: a later stage is computed on the price plus earlier taxes.

TaxRuleResponse.description: A tax rule with its dates (e.g. when cash register invoices are required).

TaxTotal.description: Total of one tax at one rate on the whole document.

base.description: Amount the tax is computed on.

payee_regime.description: The payee's regime: `household`… (a business declares itself: nothing is withheld).

TaxWithholdingRateResponse.description: A rate a platform withholds from payments to sellers.

amount.description: Amount of the line (after discounts), in the document currency; not negative.

line_id.description: The caller's id of the line, given back in the answer.

oneOf.description: Quantity, for taxes charged per unit.

TemplateInfo.description: A ready-made rule you can save now.

id.description: `<module>.<name>`.

rule.description: `{"trigger", "conditions", "actions"}`: send it to `POST /rules` with a name.

oneOf.description: Related records asked for with `expand` in `GET /api/v1/kernel/tenants`; absent otherwise.

parent_id.description: Parent tenant, when the tenant belongs to a chain.

placement.description: Name of the placement (database) that keeps its data.

read_only.description:
Read-only: its data can be read (and its users can sign in and export), but every change
is refused with `403 tenant_read_only`. Independent of `status`. Always present.

slug.description: Short name: lower-case letters, digits and `-`; unique on the platform.

status.description:
`provisioning`, `active`, `suspended` (every request is refused with
`403 tenant_suspended`), `maintenance`, `moving` or `deleted` (its data was deleted; every
request answers `404 tenant_not_found`).

TenantChanges.description: Changes to a tenant; omitted fields stay as they are.

read_only.description:
`true`: the tenant can only read (its users still sign in and export their data), every
change is refused with `403 tenant_read_only`; `false`: writable again. Independent of
`status`. The platform tenant cannot be made read-only.

reason.description:
Why (1 to 500 characters), kept with the change in the audit log (event
`kernel.tenant_updated`) — e.g. why a tenant was suspended.
reason.example: Unpaid invoices after the grace period

status.description: `active` or `suspended`. A suspended tenant refuses every request, reads included.

TenantDomain.description: A domain of the tenant: requests to a verified domain reach this tenant.

check_error.description: Why the last lookup did not verify the domain.

domain.description: Lower case, without port or trailing dot; international names in punycode.

failed_checks.description:
Daily checks in a row of the verified domain that did not find the DNS record; at 3 the
domain becomes `failed`. Keep the record in place: one successful check resets it to 0.

last_checked_at.description: Last time the DNS record was looked up.

org_id.description:
Node of the tenant's organization tree the domain belongs to (e.g. one store's own
site); `null`: the tenant as a whole. Set it with `PATCH /domains/{id}`.

record.description: The DNS record to set at your DNS provider, then call `POST /domains/{id}/verify`.

status.description:
`pending` (waits for the DNS record), `verified`, or `failed` (not verified within 7
days, or a verified domain whose record was missing at 3 daily checks in a row: fix the
record and verify again).

updated_at.description: When the status last changed; a `pending` domain fails 7 days after it.

TenantDomainChanges.description: Where a domain belongs in the tenant's organization tree.

org_id.description:
Id of a node of the tenant's organization tree (e.g. one store, for its own site), or
`null` for the tenant as a whole. Required: send `null` explicitly to detach.

TenantDomainRecord.description: The DNS record that proves the tenant owns the domain.

value.description: Exact value of the record.

retained_tables.description: Tables kept, as modules require (accounting records must be kept for years).

tables.description: Rows deleted, per table (tables with none are left out).

TenantExpanded.description:
Related records of a tenant, asked for with `expand`. All three fields are always present
(`null` when not asked for or when there is nothing).

oneOf.description: The placement that keeps the tenant's data (`expand=placement`); `null` when not asked for.

subscription.description:
The tenant's subscription (`expand=subscription`), shaped like `GET
/api/v1/plans/tenants/{tenant_id}/subscription` (`PlanSubscription`, with the plan's code
and name, without add-ons). `null` when not asked for, when the tenant has no subscription,
or without the plans module.

usage.description:
The tenant's use of every limit (`expand=usage`), shaped like `GET
/api/v1/plans/tenants/{tenant_id}/usage` (a list of `LimitUse`). `null` when not asked for
or without the plans module.

TenantExport.description: An export of all the data of a tenant.

expires_at.description: The file is deleted after this time.

reason.description: `manual`, or `subscription_canceled` when the subscription was canceled.

size.description: Size of the file in bytes, once ready.

status.description:
`pending`, `running`, `ready` (download it), `failed` (see `error`) or `expired` (deleted
after the retention days).

TenantExportLink.description: A link to download an export without signing in.

url.description:
Path to open, relative to the API, e.g. `/api/v1/kernel/exports/download?token=…`. Anyone
with it can download until `expires_at`; a new link replaces the previous one.

TenantMove.description: A move of a tenant to another placement.

error.description: Why the last run stopped, when it did; running the move again resumes it.

state.description:
`copying` (the tenant answers `503`), `copied`, `switched` (the tenant works from `to`;
the old placement is being cleaned), `done` or `aborted`.

TenantMoveBlocker.description: Why the move cannot run now.

code.description: Stable code, the same as the error a real run would answer.

TenantMovePlan.description: What a move would do (dry run). Nothing is changed.

blocking.description: What must be fixed first; empty when the move can run.

files.description:
Files of the tenant that would be copied to the file storage of `to`. `0` in two cases:
both placements keep files in the same storage (nothing to copy), or the tenant has no
files.

from.description: Placement that keeps the tenant's data now.

ready.description: `true` when nothing blocks the move (`blocking` is empty).

resumes.description: An interrupted move to `to` that a real run resumes.

settle_seconds.description:
Seconds the tenant answers `503 tenant_maintenance` before copying starts (other servers
see the move and requests in progress finish); copying takes longer for many rows.

tables.description: Rows of the tenant that would be copied, per table, in copy order.

to.description: Placement the data would move to.

TenantMoveRequest.description: Where to move the tenant's data.

dry_run.description:
Only report what the move would do, changing nothing. Defaults to `true`: send `false` to
move.

keep_source.description:
Keep the tenant's data at the old placement as a backup copy (its queued jobs and events
are removed there so nothing runs twice). Defaults to `false`: the old copy is deleted.

to.description: Name of the placement (database) to move the data to.

TenantRelocation.description: A split or merge of tenants.

error.description: Why the last run stopped; running it again resumes it.

oneOf.description: The plan made when it started (or when it was requested).

state.description:
`requested` (asked by the tenant, waiting for the platform staff), `planned`, `frozen`
(the tenants answer 503), `copied`, `verified`, `switched`, `cleaned`, `done` or `failed`.

tables.description: Rows written to the target per table (after `copied`).

TenantSettingState.description: A setting the installed modules take per tenant, and its state in the current tenant.

group.description:
Group of the setting, to filter the list by (`?group=`); `connection`: a connection to a
partner service (mail server, AI provider, payment gateway…). `null`: no group.

is_set.description: Whether this tenant has set it; otherwise the server-wide configuration applies.

last_error.description: For a setting of a partner connection: why its last use failed; omitted when it worked.

last_used_at.description:
For a setting of a partner connection: the last time the connection was used (or tested
with `POST /api/v1/kernel/settings/{name}/test`).

name.description:
`<module>.<key>`, e.g. `kernel.public_url`; a partner connection is named
`<module>.connection.<kind>.<field>`, e.g. `mail.connection.smtp.url`.

secret.description: Secret settings are stored encrypted and never returned: `value` is always `null`.

value.description: The value, for settings that are not secret and are set.

TenantSettingValue.description: The new value of a setting.

value.description: 1 to 4000 characters. Secret values are stored encrypted and never returned.

TenantTableRows.description: Rows of the tenant in one table.

TermFields.description: The name of a term in one language, and its parent. Omitted fields stay as they are.

locale.description:
The language of `name`, `slug`, `description` and the meta fields; omitted: the
default language. Needed to change those fields.

parent_id.description: Parent category (categories only); `null` moves it to the top.

slug.description: Omitted or empty: made from the name.

TermName.description: The name of a term in one language.

slug.description: Unique among the terms of the same taxonomy and language.

TermResponse.description: A category or tag, with its names in every language.

entry_count.description: How many entries (in any status) have this term. Only in the list.

parent_id.description: Parent category; `null` at the top (always for tags).

TestRequest.description: Where to send a test mail.

event_sample.description:
What the templates and conditions see as `event` (e.g. a sample payload of the trigger
event). Omit to use a sample for the trigger type.

text.description: Plain text (no HTML), 1 to 500 characters, with exactly the `{placeholders}` of the default.

TextView.description: One text a tenant may replace.

default.description: The default wording in `locale` (`null` for `ui.*` keys: the interface owns it).

legal.description: Required by law: cannot be replaced.

replies.description:
The first shown replies, oldest first (at most `replies_limit`); get the rest from
`GET /api/v1/comments/public/comments/{id}/replies`.

ThreadComment.description: A top-level comment with its first replies.

access_token.description: Send this with every request: `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.

expires_in.description: Seconds until `access_token` expires. Refresh shortly before then.

refresh_token.description:
Exchange this for a new pair at `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh`. Each refresh
token works once: always keep only the newest one. Store it securely.

refresh_token_expires_at.description: When `refresh_token` expires; after that, sign in again.

session_id.description:
The session these tokens belong to. It stays the same across refreshes; keep it

info.description:
REST API of Autoxide.

## Conventions

Every endpoint follows the same rules, so learning one endpoint teaches all of them.

- **Success**: a single result is `{"data": …}`; a list is `{"data": […], "pagination": {"limit", "next_cursor"}}`. Creating a record answers `201` with a `Location` header pointing to it.
- **Errors**: always RFC 9457 Problem Details (`application/problem+json`). Branch on the stable `code` field, never on `detail`. Validation problems list every invalid field of the request in `errors`, all at once.
- **Lists**: accept `limit` (1–200, default 50), `order` (`desc` or `asc`, by creation time) and `cursor`. Some lists also take `sort` to order by another field, and their own filters. To get the next page, pass `pagination.next_cursor` as `cursor` with the same `order`, `sort` and filters; `null` means last page.
- **Authentication**: endpoints that need it list the `bearer` security scheme. Send `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`. A `401` response carries `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`; its `code` says whether the token is missing, invalid or expired. Public endpoints list an empty requirement next to `bearer`: they work without a token, and a sent token must still be valid.
- **Retries**: send `Idempotency-Key: <a random UUID>` with `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH` and `DELETE`. Repeating the same request with the same key within 24 hours returns the first result (marked `Idempotent-Replayed: true`) instead of doing it twice; a different request with a used key gets `422`, and a repeat while the first is still running gets `409`.
- **Concurrent edits**: reading a single record returns its version in `ETag`. Send it back in `If-Match` when changing the record: if someone changed it in between, the answer is `412` (code `precondition_failed`) instead of silently overwriting their change. Without `If-Match` the change is made anyway, except on endpoints that say `If-Match` is required: those answer `428` (code `precondition_required`).
- **Caching**: send the `ETag` you have in `If-None-Match` when reading again; if nothing changed the answer is `304 Not Modified` with no body.
- **Deprecation**: an endpoint being retired is marked `deprecated` here and answers with `Deprecation` (RFC 9745), `Sunset` (RFC 8594, the removal date) and `Link: <…>; rel="successor-version"` headers. Move to the successor before the sunset date.
- **Language**: send `Accept-Language` (e.g. `vi`) to get the `detail` of errors in that language; English (`en`) by default and for unsupported languages. Responses carry `Content-Language`. Codes never change with the language.
- **Rate limits**: too many requests from one address are answered with `429` (code `rate_limited`) and a `Retry-After` header giving the seconds to wait.
- **Which tenant**: on a server with many tenants, a request is served for the tenant of its credential (the token or API key); without one, for the tenant named in the header `Autoxide-Tenant: <slug or id>`, else for the tenant whose verified domain is in `Host` (behind a trusted proxy, `X-Forwarded-Host` or `Forwarded`). A tenant endpoint that cannot tell answers `400` with code `tenant_required` (for example a domain not bound to any tenant); a header naming no tenant answers `404` with code `tenant_not_found`; a header or domain of another tenant than the credential's answers `403` with code `tenant_mismatch`. A server with one tenant ignores both.
- **Tenant state**: any endpoint of a tenant may answer `403` with code `tenant_suspended` (the tenant is suspended: nothing works, reads included), `403` with code `tenant_read_only` (the tenant can only read for now: `GET` works, as do sign-in, exports and links from mails; other changes are refused; MCP tools that are not read-only too) or `503` with code `tenant_maintenance` and a `Retry-After` header.
- **Request id**: every response carries `x-request-id`. Send your own to correlate calls; quote it when reporting a problem.
- **IDs** are UUIDv7 strings; **timestamps** are UTC in RFC 3339; **money** is an integer amount in the smallest currency unit plus a currency code.

called (or `?site=`). Batches from known bots, from pages whose `Origin` (or `Referer`) is not

who consented to `analytics.personal` have their events linked to their account; nobody else.

post.description:
Needs no sign-in: the token comes from the mail sent to the old address after the
account's email changed. The account is then locked against whoever changed it: signed
out everywhere, its password removed (sign-in with a password stops working), its API
keys, passkeys, two-step sign-in and pending tokens removed. When no other account took
the old address meanwhile, the email goes back to it and a mail to choose a new password
is sent there (in the language of `Accept-Language`); otherwise ask an administrator.
Needs no tenant header: the token names its tenant.

422.description: The body is missing a field or a value is invalid.

default.description: Any error, as RFC 9457 Problem Details. The `code` field identifies the problem.

address; sign in with it from now on. Every other verification token of the
account stops working. Needs no tenant header: the token names its tenant.

get.summary: Find free times (public).

post.description:
Signed-in customers book with their account; guests send a `phone_code` instead. Book a free time from `GET /api/v1/bookings/public/availability`. Read the terms
there first: price, deposit, cancellation. Without a deposit the booking is `confirmed` (or
`pending` when the shop approves bookings); with a deposit it is `held` for a few minutes and the
answer has a `checkout` to pay through the shop's licensed payment partner — unpaid holds are
released. Two people booking the same time: one gets it, the other `bookings.slot_taken`.

post.description:
Guests need no sign-in (unless the server or the target kind asks for it); signed-in users
need `comments.post` and a display name (`PUT /api/v1/comments/profile`). Checks run in a
fixed order: target open, length, content, duplicate, bans, banned words (refused) and
suspect words or too many links (held), anti-spam, approval mode. Every input problem is
reported at once. The answer says `published` or `pending` (waiting for approval — held
or dropped comments look the same). Guests get an `edit_token`, shown only here. Sending the
same `form_token` again returns the same comment (with a new `edit_token`).

Requires the permission of the action, and an `Idempotency-Key`. Send either `ids` (up to 500)
or `filter` with `expected_count`: when the records matching `filter` now are not
`expected_count`, nothing is done (409 `kernel.bulk_count_changed`). The action runs in a
background job with your permissions, checked on each record: follow it with
`GET /api/v1/kernel/jobs/{id}`; its `result.items` says what happened to each record (`ok`,
`skipped` with a reason, `failed` with the error `code`). With `dry_run`, nothing is done: the
answer lists the records it would act on.

get.description:
Requires sign-in, and for each event the permission its module declares (see
`stream_permission` in `GET /api/v1/kernel/modules`): the same permission as reading the record
over REST. Only events of your tenant are sent; with a permission narrower than the whole
tenant you receive only the events you caused yourself. Only events a module declares
streamable are sent — never raw table changes.

Each event is one frame: `id: <event id>`, `event: <event name>`, `data: {"id", "name",
"occurred_at", "subject", "actor_kind", "payload"}`. A `: ping` comment comes every 15 s.
Delivery is **at least once**: after a reconnect you may receive an event again — skip ids you
already have. Reconnect with the `Last-Event-ID` header (browsers' `EventSource` does it for
you) or `last_event_id` to receive what you missed; events are kept 7 days, and when the id is
older the stream sends `event: reset` first — reload your data over REST. The server closes a
stream after 30 minutes and when it shuts down; reconnect the same way. Disabled unless the
server sets `AUTOXIDE_EVENTS_STREAM=true`.

the module you may see. The module catalog lists each event's `stream_permission`.

post.description:
No sign-in needed. The answer is the same `202` whether the address is new, waiting for
confirmation, already subscribed, blocked, or dropped by the anti-spam checks: nobody can
learn which addresses are on a list. A confirmation mail links to
`AUTOXIDE_NEWSLETTER_CONFIRM_URL` for lists with double opt-in, for sign-ups held by the
anti-spam checks, and — on any list — for an address that unsubscribed from it or is still
waiting for confirmation (nobody can sign someone else back up); at most
`AUTOXIDE_NEWSLETTER_CONFIRM_MAILS_PER_DAY` sign-up requests a day for one address may send
one. Send `form_token` (and `challenge` when the server uses one); only a caller with the
permission `newsletter.subscribe` (a website server with its own API key) may omit them —
other signed-in callers go through the same checks as anonymous visitors. Sending the same
`form_token` again stores nothing new. The sign-up is stored, and the confirmation mail
sent, by a background job shortly after the answer, so the answer takes the same time
whatever the address.

apps send `POST` with the form body `List-Unsubscribe=One-Click` (RFC 8058). Unsubscribes
the address from the list of that mail at once. The answer is the same for any token. The
token tells the tenant: the link works on any host of the API, without `Autoxide-Tenant`.

`consent_source` kept as proof of consent. Known addresses are updated; someone who

safely with an `Idempotency-Key` header.

post.description:
No sign-in needed; only when the server takes sign-ups (`AUTOXIDE_PLANS_SIGNUP`), on the platform
host, for plans marked `self_signup`. The answer is the same `202` whether the request is new,
repeats one still waiting (same email and slug: a new mail, the old link stops working), or was
dropped by the anti-spam checks. A background job then mails a link valid 24 hours; the person
opens it and the page sends the token to `POST /signups/confirm`. Send `form_token` (and
`challenge` when the server uses one). Two people waiting for the same `slug`: the first to get
to the provisioning keeps it, the other is `rejected` (`tenant_slug_taken`).

parameters.name: Accept-Language

422.description: A value is invalid (e.g. `plan_code` not open to sign-up, `slug` taken, `accept_terms` not `true`); every problem in `errors`.

default.description: Any error, as RFC 9457 Problem Details. The `code` field identifies the problem.

post.description:
No sign-in needed. Records that the person accepted the current terms of use and privacy policy.
When the plan needs identity checks the sign-up becomes `awaiting_kyc` and `kyc` says where to do
them (calling again while waiting starts new checks); otherwise the tenant is created in the
background (`provisioning`, then `completed`, and the person gets an invitation to administer
it). Calling again later answers the sign-up as it stands. Keep the token: it also reads the
sign-up (`GET /signups/{id}?token=`).

parameters.name: Accept-Language

404.description: This server does not take sign-ups; code `plans.signup_disabled`.

503.description: Identity checks cannot start now (`plans.kyc_unavailable`, `compliance.verification_disabled`); try again later.

default.description: Any error, as RFC 9457 Problem Details. The `code` field identifies the problem.

post.description:
Requires `webhooks.manage`. From now on, every event it subscribes to is sent to
`url` as a signed `POST` (Standard Webhooks headers `webhook-id`,
`webhook-timestamp`, `webhook-signature`); answer with any 2xx within 10 seconds
(`AUTOXIDE_WEBHOOKS_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`).
Other answers are retried with growing delays for about two hours. The response
carries the signing secret, shown only once.
